lucy_cs: Sequoia Health wants a short-term APAC peering lift + CIDR allowlist for tomorrow's final sync. Can we triage?

pat_ops: Yes. Need CIDRs, region, target QPS, duration, and a one-line biz justification.

lucy_cs: CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24, 198.51.100.77/32. Region: ap-southeast-1. Baseline 35 -> request 260 QPS for 48h. Reason: bulk user import + warmup to avoid 429s. They also asked about KV pre-warm for top prefixes.

omar_eng: I'll prepare rate-limiter & allowlist change; will add auto-revoke at 48h and quick synthetic tests. Staging example: `redwoodctl customers update --id sequoia-health --allowlist 198.51.100.0/24,198.51.100.77 --qps 260 --region ap-southeast-1 --revoke-in 48h`

pat_ops: Creating change request now. @lucy_cs paste a sanitized prod payload for the runbook.

lucy_cs: Prod payload (sanitized): {"customer_id":"sequoia-health","change":{"region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":260,"allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24","198.51.100.77/32"],"auto_revoke":"48h"},"requested_by":"lucy_cs"}

infra-bot: infra-bot: change-request created (#CS-8310) by pat_ops - awaiting review

omar_eng: Staging applied; synthetic burst to 320 QPS passed. Scheduling prod window at 11:00 UTC in ~10m. Watch: QPS, 5xx, p99 latency. Rollback if 5xx > 1% or error spike > baseline +0.5%.

pat_ops: Deployed at 11:02 UTC. Control plane returned revoke ts: 2026-04-05T11:02:00Z. CLI output saved to runbook.

lucy_cs: Customer confirms traffic flowing; 5xx ~0.18%, latency within SLO. I'll run KV cache warmup for top-20 prefixes and attach logs.

joel_ae: I'll ping the account in renewal thread (renewal ~27 days), share this runbook and usage snapshot. Positive ops signal reduces churn risk.

lucy_cs: Action items: 1) Verify auto-revoke fires (pat_ops), 2) add KB for KV pre-warm and attach logs (lucy_cs), 3) AE renewal outreach with usage dashboard (joel_ae). Closing unless issues.
